I was digging more into the code and seems that the config address is used here

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/174b6d0e2fc99d9964a7d5a7484aa0b7d50b4be1/pkg/kubelet/server/streaming/server.go#L238

and I think that the empty address fits better in this situation,
 
>, if the host in the address parameter is empty .... Listen listens on all available unicast and anycast IP addresses of the local system
> If the port in the address parameter is empty or "0",...,  a port number is automatically chosen.

https://golang.org/pkg/net/#Listen

Also, I'm curious because I've seen it come up in a couple of diffs - what are k8s expectations around ipv6? Is k8s expected to function completely normally if ipv6 is disabled on the hosts running the different k8s components?

I think that k8s should work normally in ipv4 only and ipv6 only environments, that are the modes that it supports currently, but maybe is more an architectural question ...

I do not think the right answer is to listen on every interface (what this does).  "localhost" is supposed to work.  It's one of those things that underpins everything.

From your comment, I'm understanding that setting to `""` means that now we are listening on more IP address than just localhost? Is this a security concern?

Is there an option where we still specify `localhost` but do so in a way that doesn't require ipv6?

Regardless of the path forward, it'd be great to have a descriptive variable/function name to make it clearer the purpose of `config.Addr = ""`.

> From your comment, I'm understanding that setting to "" means that now we are listening on more IP address than just localhost? Is this a security concern?

that's my concern too, I really don't know what's the purpose of using `localhost`, that`s why assigned the PR to the patch author :)

> Is there an option where we still specify localhost but do so in a way that doesn't require ipv6?

The problem is, AFAIK,  this depends on the OS mechanism to resolve `localhost` and its preference. 

> Regardless of the path forward, it'd be great to have a descriptive variable/function name to make it clearer the purpose of config.Addr = "".

Is not the address where the streaming server is listening?

The problem seems to be that "localhost" is resolving to an IPv6 address, but IPv6 is disabled, right?

Isn't that just a bad configuration on the machine?
